cases.name: agent_provision
assertions: agent provision operation id remains ak.self.agent.command.provision
agent provision capability action matches the operation id
provision fails without a controller recovery policy before creating any Agent DID, PCR, or grant side effect
prepare allocates agent_id and principal_control_realm_id without durable Agent, PCR, accountability, selector, pairing or grant side effects
the controller recomputes requested_scope_digest and uses the Arkret SDK canonical authoring API for both payload proofs, effects and Event envelopes
commit accepts exactly one controller-signed ak.identity.accountability_grant and one controller-signed ak.agent.selector_claim whose source_refs binds the accountability Event id
both provisioning Events pass the ordinary Event proof verifier and admission pipeline; a service-authored, payload-only or dev-proof substitute is rejected in every mode
an exact commit retry identified by the allocated agent_id and two Event ids returns the original outcome, while an Event-id byte mismatch conflicts
a crash after admitting only the first Event is recovered by replaying the same closed pair and never by minting replacement Event ids or proofs
complete returns the Agent PCR binding with pcr_recovery pending and does not pre-write an Agent profile or runtime key authorization
requested_scope is required, immutable and records a global hard ceiling rather than a grant
the accepted Agent DID service entry is a closed four-field binding that fixes only the domain-separated requested_scope digest and contains no complete scope
pairing and grant admission require a controller-signed verifier-bound private requested_scope disclosure whose digest matches the accepted-at DID commitment
provisioning writes only accountability and selector facts and never materializes Realm grants
a narrower per-key scope is accepted while a wider action/resource scope or omitted mandatory provision constraint is rejected
a narrower Realm grant is accepted while an omitted action or out-of-ceiling content resource is rejected with agent_grant_exceeds_requested_scope
missing accountability grants fail with accountability_grant_missing

cases.name: agent_requested_scope_privacy
assertions: the public did:webvh history never contains the complete requested_scope, resource selectors, or constraints
the disclosure validates against agent-requested-scope-disclosure.schema.json and its controller proof payload_digest
the verifier consumes request_id and challenge once and rejects replay, wrong audience, stale proof, and digest mismatch
accepted disclosure is stored only as encrypted verifier-private evidence keyed by agent, digest, verifier, and audience

cases.name: agent_pairing_expiry
assertions: agent key-pair operation id remains ak.gate.account.command.pair_agent_key
expired pairing requests fail with pairing_request_expired
DID mismatch, invalid proof, expired pairing, and deactivated agent errors are all pinned

cases.name: agent_runtime_key_binding
assertions: same stable binding retry retains approval_request_id and notification id and emits action update
a runtime persists and reuses one local key binding for an open pairing_request_id across process restart and channel delete/recreate
a runtime that loses the bound key stops and renews pairing instead of overwriting the pending request with a different key
different stable binding on one open pairing_request_id fails with HTTP 409 agent_runtime_request_conflict without replacement
final approval recomputes the current stable binding and full ak.agent.key_pairing_request_binding.v1 digest from persistence
pairing request binding expiry is parsed and normalized to UTC RFC 3339 with exactly three fractional digits before hashing
microsecond and offset spellings that normalize to the same UTC millisecond produce the same pairing request binding digest
a stale controller approval fails closed
pairing code, proof of possession and attestation bytes never appear in the account notification delta
the authenticated pending_runtime_key_request controller projection is closed and omits pairing_code, requested_scope_disclosure and authorize_event

cases.name: agent_managed_pcr_separation
assertions: agent DID document has one ArkretPrincipalControlRealm service entry binding a non-controller PCR id
agent PCR genesis created_by and notary equal the agent DID and both encryption floors are e2ee_required
controller-authored agent PCR events use actor_id equal to agent DID, executed_by equal to controller DID, and a verified authorization_ref
delegated admission fails when the accepted-at delegation purpose or resource scope does not cover the target Event kind and Agent PCR
agent profile, key authorization and lifecycle events land in the agent PCR
accountability grant and agent selector claim land in the controller PCR
pairing requests and approval notifications land in neither PCR
a non-PCR Realm at either principal_control_realm_id fails closed

cases.name: agent_repairing_supersede
assertions: renew_pairing requires a paused agent and leaves status, existing keys, and grants untouched
renew_pairing returns pairing_mode replacement and the current pcr_recovery projection without resetting it to pending
issuing a new pairing handle makes every previous handle permanently unresolvable
one controller-signed authorize event carries an exact supersedes set and atomically replaces every prior active authorization dot with reason superseded_by_repairing
stale, partial, extra, or wrong authorized_event_ref supersedes sets fail closed without changing any key
sessions issued from superseded keys fail closed within the revocation freshness window
replacement handle expiry has no side effects and never yields pairing_expired on a previously keyed agent
renew_pairing on a deactivated agent fails with agent_deactivated

cases.name: agent_managed_pcr_recovery
assertions: provision returns the Agent PCR binding with pcr_recovery pending and never pre-authorizes a runtime key
the controller E2EE client, never the server, generates Agent PCR MLS private state
managed Agent PCR MLS state is stored in a controller-owned mls_history envelope encrypted to the controller recovery public key
public contents, plaintext keybag, and AEAD AAD carry the same canonical managed principal binding set
pairing commits only while the active backup tail covers the current Agent PCR Seal frontier and MLS epoch
an accepted pairing advances the Agent PCR frontier, makes recovery stale, and requires a post-commit backup tail before the next pairing
pending, stale, missing, cross-actor, secret-storage-key-only, or binding-mismatched recovery states fail with agent_pcr_recovery_not_ready without consuming the pairing handle
Agent runtime private keys are never backed up or cloned and replacement always generates a fresh local key
a Native Personal Agent has no independent human-facing mnemonic; controller recovery restores PCR continuity but does not bypass current delegation or capability checks

cases.name: agent_longevity_no_expiry
assertions: agent key authorization without expires_at is accepted and remains valid until revoked
same-key re-authorization atomically removes all observed authorization dots and adds one replacement dot
concurrent same-key re-authorizations fold to the intersection of scope and audience and the earliest finite expiry
accountability grant without expires_at is accepted and verifies accountable_principal_ids
low and medium risk agent grants without temporal constraints are accepted
session issuance long after provisioning succeeds while the chain is unrevoked
pause fails closed new sessions and invalidates issued sessions within the freshness window
high risk agent grants without expires_at fail with failed_precondition

cases.name: agent_controller_lifecycle
assertions: agent lifecycle operation ids retain canonical namespaces
active to paused to active to deactivated is accepted
deactivated is terminal and resume fails with agent_deactivated
pause while paused fails with agent_paused

cases.name: agent_act_on_behalf
assertions: controller approvals are single-use
approval replay fails with approval_already_consumed
act-on-behalf without authorization_ref, participation, matching grant scope, or fresh approval fails closed
unauthorised sidecar creation fails with sidecar_create_denied

cases.name: agent_session_grant_replay
assertions: session grant issue operation id remains ak.gate.account.command.issue_session_grant
agent_key_proof challenge replay, audience mismatch, and bad signature fail closed
agent session branch rejects invalid proofs, DID mismatch, paused agents, and deactivated agents
accountability grant absence is pinned as accountability_grant_missing

cases.name: agent_human_approval_required
assertions: error details validate against agent_human_approval_error_details
approval_request_id is opaque and is the only runtime-visible correlation handle
controller approval completes out of band
agent retry references accepted approval evidence
no interactive human challenge is returned to the agent runtime
